title: Preventing the Scourge of Online Gambling in Singapore
what_it_is: Preventing the Scourge of Online Gambling in Singapore

sections.label: Online gambling prevention measures questioned
sections.summary: The speaker asks what new upstream, midstream and downstream measures the Government instituted against online gambling since the 2014 Remote Gambling Bill.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The answers did not suggest any specific initiatives introduced by the Government since the debate on the Remote Gambling Bill in 2014 to tackle the online gambling realm any differently from terrestrial gambling, even though the Government has acknowledged that its methods of outreach between terrestrial and online gambling have to be different.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: So, I would like to ask the Minister again, what new upstream, midstream and downstream measures has the Government instituted to prevent the scourge of online gambling since the passage of this Bill in 2014.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: One would have thought that it ought to have been imperative for the Government to go public with these new initiatives well before granting exemptions to Singapore Pools and the Turf Club to offer online gambling services starting from October 2016.

sections.label: Spain online gambling study
sections.summary: A 2015 Spanish study found a significant increase in pathological gamblers two years after online gambling was legalised there.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: A 2015 study in Spain found a significant increase in pathological gamblers two years after the legalisation of online gambling in that country.

sections.label: Online gambling revenue regressive tax
sections.summary: Because problem gambling disproportionately affects the poor, online gambling revenues act as a regressive tax on the most vulnerable.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Since problem gambling disproportionately affects the poor, collecting revenues from online gambling is, in effect, a regressive tax on the most vulnerable in our society.

sections.label: Singapore Pools online betting timeline
sections.summary: A timeline states Singapore Pools hired OpenBet in July 2015 and launched its online betting website in October 2016 after exemptions were granted.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: July 2015: Straits Times reported that Singapore Pools had hired OpenBet to replace its website with one that can offer sports betting, and the contract is estimated to be worth $10 million. 15 September 2016: Singapore Pools and STC were reported to be running final tests on their new online betting websites. 29 September 2016: The Government granted exemptions to Singapore Pools and STC. 25 October 2016: Singapore Pools launched new online betting website, although this was not widely reported in the mainstream media.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: It would be a huge gamble to sink $10 million into a contract without knowing whether it would pay off.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Yet, more than one year before the exemptions were granted, Singapore Pools appeared to have done exactly that.

sections.label: Reviewing Singapore Pools exemptions
sections.summary: The Minister is asked under what circumstances the Government will review the exemptions granted to Singapore Pools and the Turf Club.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: To this end, will the Minister inform this House under what circumstances the Government will review the exemptions granted currently to Singapore Pools and the Turf Club and how it plans to review them in an ongoing manner?

sections.label: Problem gambler family impact
sections.summary: International studies found each problem gambler negatively impacts an average eight to 10 family members, colleagues and friends.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: International studies have found that each problem gambler negatively impacts an average eight to 10 family members, colleagues and friends.

sections.label: Online gambling exemptions review
sections.summary: The Government should review exemptions by adding stricter circuit breakers, tying limits to salary, and requiring Singapore Pools and the Turf Club to collect detailed statistics.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: As part of its ongoing review of the exemptions, the Government should look into implementing more stringent "circuit breakers", for example, tying expenditure and daily funding limits on online gambling to an individual's salary or a scale of that salary, and to deliberately set as a low percentage of one's salary or removing the user-defined funding and expenditure limits.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Separately, Singapore Pools and the Turf Club should be required to collect detailed statistics so that the Government and the public can better study the trends of online gambling.

sections.label: Legalising online gambling opposed
sections.summary: Legalising online gambling is a step in the wrong direction.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Legalising online gambling is a step in the wrong direction.

sections.label: Global online gambling market
sections.summary: There is a large global online gambling market, estimated at some US$40 billion in 2015 and growing 6% to 8% annually over five years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: First, there is a large global market for online gambling, estimated at some US$40 billion in 2015, growing annually at 6% to 8% over the last five years.

sections.label: Arrests for illegal online gambling
sections.summary: Since 2015, the Police have arrested more than 120 people for illegal online gambling in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Since 2015, for example, the Police have arrested more than 120 people for illegal online gambling in Singapore.

sections.label: Singapore online gambling estimate
sections.summary: Some analysts estimate that in Singapore in 2015, online gambling amounted to as large as S$461 million.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Some analysts estimates that in Singapore in 2015, online gambling amounted to as large as S$461 million.

sections.label: Online football betting arrests
sections.summary: In 2015, 90% of those arrested for illegal football betting were involved in online football gambling.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: In 2015, 90% of those who were arrested for illegal football betting were involved in online football gambling.

sections.label: Comprehensive online gambling system
sections.summary: The Government says a comprehensive system is needed, with a broad online gambling prohibition and an exempt operator valve with social safeguards.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The Government's view is that a comprehensive system is needed to tackle this dimension, as the Member says – upstream, downstream, midstream – which has both a law and order dimension, as well as a social dimension, and we have to tackle both.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: So, what we have put in place is a broad and extensive prohibition against online gambling, and an exempt operator valve that comes with social safeguards and an exclusion system set amidst public education and outreach and counselling.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: This broadly mirrors the approach that we have taken for terrestrial gambling.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: So, we need a valve – legal, run by non-profit organisations where people have to sign up so we know who they are, with mechanisms to promote responsible gaming for us to intervene early before the problem gets out of hand.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We also intend to work with the exempt operators to study the impact: whether there is displacement; what is the online gambling prevalence after the scheme is put in place; and then whether further tweaks, adjustments and changes to policy need to be undertaken.

sections.label: Pritam Singh total ban push
sections.summary: Mr Pritam Singh pushed for a total ban on online gambling and does not believe it will push the problem underground.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Mr Pritam Singh, in particular, pushed for a total ban on online gambling and he does not believe it will push the problem underground.

sections.label: Workers' Party ban positions
sections.summary: Mr Singh said a total ban will not drive online gambling underground, while Mr Png Eng Huat said a ban will drive it underground.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: During the Second Reading of the Bill in 2014, Mr Singh said that a total ban will not drive online gambling underground, whereas Mr Png Eng Huat contradicted him in the very same debate where he said categorically that a ban will drive the problem underground, and I quote, "It is the law of nature." So, Madam, what is the Workers' Party's true position on this matter?

sections.label: One minute left reminder
sections.summary: The Speaker notes Senior Minister of State Lee has one minute left and says workable solutions must be put forward and implemented for Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Speaker
sentences.text: Senior Minister of State Lee, you only have one minute left.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We are expected to put forward workable solutions for consultation and debate, and we have to implement a solution for Singaporeans.

sections.label: Banning versus valve approach
sections.summary: Banning slows growth but is inadequate alone, while a valve allows gambling with social safeguards and lets the problem be tracked.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Banning it will help slow the pace of growth.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: On its own, it is inadequate, because the problem will go deeper and we will simply be burying our heads in the sand.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: A valve may allow people who intend to gamble online to do so in an environment with some social safeguards, and we can track the size and shape of the problem and implement further policies.
